reasoning_content: Now I'll check the key files to understand how the 3D client handles network connections.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check WorldService
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("head -80 /opt/areloria/client/src/game/world/services/WorldService.ts")
print("WorldService:", stdout.read().decode()[:2500])

# Check WorldContext
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("head -60 /opt/areloria/client/src/context/WorldContext.js")
print("\nWorldContext:", stdout.read().decode()[:2000])

c.close()
EOF
